items.name: Connector reliability improvement discovery
items.description: Identify the source connectors and import flows that create the highest support load or data trust risk.
questions: Which source systems create the most failed sync runs?
Which import validation errors are confusing enough to create support tickets?
Which connector freshness signals should be exposed to customer admins?

items.name: Audit evidence operations discovery
items.description: Find operational improvements that reduce friction in access review, evidence export, and compliance review workflows.
questions: Which audit exports are most often requested by enterprise risk and security teams?
Which access review steps create avoidable delays?
Which compliance evidence should be prepackaged for customer security reviews?
